# Dandeli Kali River Rafting

> White-water rafting operator on the Kali River at Ganeshgudi, near Dandeli, Karnataka, India. Offers short, mid and long rafting routes plus kayaking, ziplines, jungle safaris, riverside camping and day/stay packages. Bookings online or on WhatsApp.

- Website: https://dandelikaliriverrafting.com/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99020 14064
- Email: dandelikaliriverraftings@gmail.com
- Address: Ganeshgudi, Ilava, Dandeli, Ambeli, Karnataka 581365, India
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NsshXPKLpgvYYTJk6
- Hours: Open daily, 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Rafting takes place at Ganeshgudi, about 20 km from Dandeli town, not in the town itself. Availability depends on daily water release from the Supa dam, so call or WhatsApp before travelling.

## Rafting prices (per person)

- Short Rafting — 1 km, about 40 minutes, beginner level: ₹700
- Mid Rafting — 5 km, about 1.5 hours, moderate: ₹1,350
- Long Rafting — 11 km, about 3 hours, moderate: ₹1,750

Every rafter wears a life jacket and helmet, and a certified guide rides in every raft.

## Packages

- Day Thrill Package: ₹1,599
- Stay Package: ₹2,699
- Premium River Side Stay Package: ₹4,599

## Other activities (per person)

River zip-line ₹350, river kayaking ₹300, water zorbing ₹300, roller coaster zipline (480 m) ₹1,400, canopy walk ₹600, sky cycling ₹400, giant swing ₹400, jungle safari ₹800, bird watching ₹650, trekking ₹250, jungle camping ₹1,800, riverside camping ₹1,800.
